scope: Immediate ordered Pull/Fetch/Push editable-history deletion, source next/previous/empty selection and native open-popup Shift+Delete receiver. Partial parity; full port remains incomplete.

verification.native: Deletion receiver passed system Git and Git 2.37.1, 2.39.5 and bundled 2.55.0. Real native Fetch/Pull/Push models verify immediate ordered saves, middle/last/only entry next/previous/empty selection, invalid-index/busy refusal, shared Pull/Fetch histories, scoped Push keys, and Cancel/reopen persistence. HEAD/index/config remain byte-identical. Actual hidden editable combo verifies initial selected index/text, delegate popup notifications and direct NSEvent-based key-handler calls for Shift+Forward Delete/Shift+Mac Delete, unshifted/closed/disabled/no-permission gates; no events sent into the app. Incremental native item removal retains list order and popup-state flag. Hidden window closes. This does not prove physical popup event routing or gestures.
verification.regressions: Existing Pull/Fetch and Push history native matrices passed all four Git versions after final shared-control changes. Actual URL Pull/named Fetch/URL and named Push/deletion, source gates/history snapshot/clipboard/identity and hidden combo callbacks retained. Both native regression matrices and deletion matrix also passed before incremental list-removal refinement. No core test suite rerun: core unchanged and native fixtures directly verify Git preservation/workflows.
verification.iterations: Initial Debug and first native matrices passed. Free-text assignment moved after native selection updates to preserve manually typed values. Single-item deletion then refined to remove that item from the native list rather than rebuild it; final Debug and all three native matrices passed. No runtime failure.
verification.builds: Final unsigned Debug and AppStore builds, both bundle audits and exact bundled NOTICE comparisons passed. All 96 original icons verified; Store --require-git audited 11 universal Git Mach-O files and fixture operations; EditorConfig/IssueRegex audits passed.
verification.documentation: README feature/link, Pull/Fetch/Push parity, HistoryCombo partial source inventory and NOTICE updated. Inventory pin regression and seven-column CSV validation passed. Local site generated, unpublished.
verification.ci: Added headless native history-deletion receiver to macOS workflow. Hosted CI/push remain unverified, authentication unavailable, no retry.
verification.processes: All compiler/native/audit sessions terminal. No main app or displayed popup launched. Owned hidden control windows closed. Final app/receiver process audit empty. Eight empty owned UUID preference files each for HistoryDeletion, FetchHistory and PushHistory removed across two matrices; unrelated preferences retained.
verification.limitations: Physical popup event routing/window scope/highlight behavior, field-editor focus, actual Shift+Delete/Forward Delete/Escape, source return-key/wheel behavior, full HistoryCombo acceptance, resize/theme/accessibility and signed sandbox execution remain pending. Mac backspace-key Shift+Delete is an explicit native addition to source Windows Shift+VK_DELETE. Full application/dialog parity, Finder activation, genuine updated screenshots/full manual, hosted publication and signed App Store distribution/license clearance remain incomplete.
